_comment: Copy to credentials.json (gitignored) and fill in your own OAuth app credentials. Each provider needs an app you register with that provider; Orbix ships no shared credentials. Leave a value empty to keep that provider disabled - the app then shows an in-product setup guide when the user tries to connect it.
_microsoft: Azure Portal -> App registrations -> your app -> Application (client) ID. Add redirect URI http://127.0.0.1 (loopback).
_google: Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials -> OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Desktop app). Enable the Gmail and Calendar APIs.
_github: GitHub -> Settings -> Developer settings -> OAuth Apps.
_linkedin: linkedin.com/developers -> your app. Register redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:51237/callback exactly.
